title: Dilation maps unit-lattice chains to ρ-lattice chains
statement: Dilation of lattice chains. Let N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, k ∈ ℕ and β : LatticeFaceIndex k N → ℝ, and let X, Y ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k on Eucl N). Suppose Y(ω) = X(η) for all test k-forms ω, η with η(x) = ρ^k ω(ρx) for all x. If X(ω) = Σ'_F β_F [[F]](ω) over the faces of the unit lattice (IsLatticeChain 1 β X), then Y(ω) = Σ'_F β_F [[ρF]](ω) over the faces of the ρ-lattice (IsLatticeChain ρ β Y).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) → Y ω = X η) → ∀ β : LatticeFaceIndex k N → ℝ, IsLatticeChain 1 β X → IsLatticeChain ρ β Y
